About Smart Foods

Snacking, kept honest since 2005

Smart Foods set out to put healthy, tasty and hygienic snacks within easy reach of every household. What began as a small namkeen counter has grown into a brand people return to for its consistent taste, freshness and easy availability.

Our forte is traditional Indian namkeen — mixtures, sev, wafers and fasting-friendly farali snacks — made from carefully sourced ingredients and best-practice production. Potato wafers and aloo sev remain the household favourites, loved from kids to grandparents.
